title: Qualcomm’s latest chip hints that more powerful smart glasses could be on the way
brief: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon Reality Elite chip designed to power next-generation smart glasses and XR devices, featuring a 60% GPU performance boost. The chip was revealed at Augmented World Expo and will power Google's forthcoming Aura glasses for Android XR, marking a significant upgrade in on-device processing for wearable AR/XR applications.
